about: Ruby answering Opal on the desktop, day 1 of the-yield: she should talk TO Opal ('Opal, you...'), not about her (Gemma: 'Opal's tea is so sweet! Her footsteps are light').

messages.heard: So this is the spirit you keep talking about! It's so bright in here. Do you come every day?
You knocked on my wall three times last night. Were you scared of the storm, Saint?
I saved you half my honey cake, you know. Don't tell the attendants.
